theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_deformation_minimal_stationary
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → tsupport Z ⊆ U → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))) → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0
